_comment_launcher: How to launch the Workbench exe: auto (default; Linux->proton, else native) | native | proton | steam. The fields below only apply to Linux/Proton and are auto-detected when omitted.
_comment_linux_example: On Linux, a typical config is just: { "workbenchPath": "/home/<you>/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Arma Reforger Tools", "gamePath": "/path/to/Arma Reforger" (or a dedicated-server install), "projectPath": "/path/to/your/mods" }. launcher=auto picks Proton and auto-detects the Proton install, Steam root, and compatdata prefix.
